_readme: Manual answers for films the matcher can't resolve on its own.
Keys are the normalized title: lowercase, no accents, no punctuation.
When a film comes out UNRESOLVED, its film_id in data/films.json is
exactly the key to use here.
Find the film on themoviedb.org and take the number from its URL:
tmdb_id   force this TMDb film, skipping the matcher entirely
csfd_url  use this exact CSFD page instead of a search link
skip      true = ignore this title completely (not a film, e.g. an event)

mouchy._comment: Fernando Eimbcke's 'Moscas' (2026). TMDb has no Czech title for it at all, so no title search can find it - this needs a manual id. Verified: director and 99min runtime both match Aero's listing.
